eventMetadata.context_description: Alabama's wave of high-profile opt-outs, including star quarterback Jalen Milroe's NFL Draft declaration alongside key receivers like Ryan Williams and Germie Bernard, has eroded the Crimson Tide's talent edge, fueling Texas Tech's slight 50.5% implied probability as trader consensus in their Sun Bowl clash. Both 6-6 squads endured inconsistent regular seasons—Alabama stumbling post-Nick Saban, Texas Tech leaning on reliable QB Behren Morton—but the Red Raiders boast stronger roster continuity with fewer departures. This personnel parity creates the tight market, though late transfer portal exits, final injury reports, or bowl practice momentum could swing odds, underscoring bowl games' unpredictability amid roster flux.
